rules: Use product-type identity plus contextual gender/age/domain signals; never first-match alone.
Marketing words such as gift, trending, summer and Christmas are tags, not product identity.
Word boundaries are required for ambiguous short tokens such as men, cap and ring.
Specific canonical shelf identity outranks generic accessory terms.
Ambiguous rows are excluded from autofill until reviewed.

profit_profile.name: HUNT-CJ-2026-v1
profit_profile.distinction: 35% is the pricing target; 20% is the minimum profitability gate. A destination may pass above 20% while remaining below the 35% target.

destination_profit.rule: PROFIT_PASS is destination-specific and requires fresh stock, exact variant, fresh shipping and economics PASS.
destination_profit.global_rule: Global PROFIT_PASS is not set until every required launch market has fresh destination truth.

shelf_rule: Shadow QA may display taxonomy-safe PROFIT_REVIEW products; SELL_READY requires destination PROFIT_PASS.
